meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 当容器化的智能体系统出故障时,Claude会检查错误日志、会话数据库和挂载点,指出问题所在并给出处理办法。
howto.when: 当出现系统运行异常、容器失败或认证错误等情况,或你想了解容器系统原理时触发。

say.text: 容器没回复,帮我查错误日志和入站消息状态。
我怀疑有两个服务在同时运行,帮我停掉旧的那个。
say.note: Claude 会检查进程列表和 systemd 服务。

say.text: 帮我重启 group-a 的容器,然后立刻发一条测试消息。

howto.what_en: When the container-based agent system misbehaves, Claude inspects error logs, session databases, and mounted paths, then identifies the problem and suggests how to fix it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when things aren't working, container fails, authentication errors occur, or the user wants to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container isn't replying. Check the error log and inbound messages.
I suspect two service instances are running. Please stop the stale one.
say_en.note: Claude checks process list and systemd units.

say_en.text: Restart the group-a container and send a test message right away.
